description: This repository follows its own presets. The only dependencies here are those of validate.yml, its actions and the Renovate it validates with, and it runs on every pull request, so a patch update is merged once the presets still validate

customManagers.description: validate.yml runs a pinned Renovate, given to npx as renovate@<version>, which no built-in manager reads. Updating the pin is how the presets meet a newer Renovate: a release that asks for a migration fails only this pull request. It is left out of the github-actions group, so that such a failure does not hold back the actions
